text: dsh-composer-plus 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面增加会话和项目工具，通过客户端扩展与 Host API 提供可切换功能。它支持消息正文搜索、聊天回退与文件恢复、Markdown 导出、队列编辑及项目记忆，适合需要管理 DSH 会话与工作项目的开发者；无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-composer-plus adds session and project tools to the DeepSeek Harness web interface. Features include message search, chat rollback and file restore, Markdown export, queue editing, and project memory. It suits DSH users managing chats and projects; no extra API key is required.
我想在 DSH 里搜索聊天消息的正文内容。
能不能把一次对话回退到我之前发的那条消息？
我想把会话导出成 Markdown 文件。
如何在 DSH 里整理项目记忆并在不同会话复用？
我想编辑和调整正在等待发送的消息队列。
能否从手机访问 DSH 中的会话？
I want to search inside my DSH conversation messages.
How can I export a chat transcript as a Markdown file?
dsh-composer-plus 的功能「消息内容搜索」：启用后，DSH 侧边栏搜索可匹配聊天消息正文并显示片段；开关保存在本机设置中，重启后生效。
dsh-composer-plus 的功能「回合回退」：从用户消息旁的回退操作撤回该消息之后的聊天内容，并可将项目文件恢复到对应快照；也支持撤销回退。
dsh-composer-plus 的功能「导出 Markdown」：从聊天菜单触发，将会话消息整理为 Markdown，可复制到剪贴板或保存为文件。
dsh-composer-plus 的功能「项目记忆」：在项目或全局范围管理记忆笔记，并在会话中提供相关记忆能力；也可从聊天建议可保存的记忆。
dsh-composer-plus 的功能「手机连接」：用户开启设置后启动 Tether 网关，让 iPhone 应用连接 DSH；移动连接默认关闭。

dsh-composer-plus README · Install：**Desktop app:** Settings → Plugins → **Add plugin** → enter `dsh-composer-plus` → **Enable now**.
You can also paste `https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus` instead of the npm name.

**Web / CLI profile:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-plus
```

Then restart dsh. (The CLI can't install into the desktop profile; the app manages it.)

> dsh's pnpm skips versions younger than 24 hours. Right after a release, add the version: `dsh-composer-plus@1.23.0`.

Click a card to show only those branches; click it again to show all. Each branch is a box with its last commit: green when the main branch has its work, orange when not, blue for the main branch. An arrow goes from each branch to the branch that took it (✅ **Merged**) or to the branch that it started from (⏳ **Waiting**, dashed). Click a box to see the branch's commits, then click a commit to see its files and their diffs. Click **Merged** to see the files of the merge commit, or **Waiting** to see the files that the branch brings into its target. A remote branch shows only when no local branch has the same name. In the mode menu, pick **Uncommitted**, **Unstaged**, **Staged** or **Branch** to see changed files with `+/-` counts; click a file for its diff. **Last Turn** opens dsh's own review of the latest turn. **This chat** lists only the file

Buttons, tooltips, notices and notifications follow the selected dsh language (see Application language below).

dsh-composer-plus README · Settings：Every feature can be switched on or off on its own: dsh **Settings → Composer Plus**. Each row has a small screenshot: hover it for a larger preview, click it to open it full size (`Esc` closes). The **Search features** box at the top filters the page by name or description (any language, case- and accent-insensitive); `Esc` clears it. Next to it, **All**, **On** and **Off** show every feature, only the features that are on, or only the ones that are off (switch off **On/off filter** to hide them). Each row has a switch and a short description; changes apply immediately, without a restart, and are remembered on that device. The small **?** after a row's name opens the part of this README that describes that feature, in the README of dsh's interface language. Everything is on by default, except **Mobile connect**, **Resume after restart** and **Complete while typing**. dsh's Host keeps the switches of these three and of **Content search**, **Turn rollback**, **Next message prediction** and **Goal check**, so they apply to every window and survive a restart. The Host also keeps the **Model** choice of **Next message prediction**, the one of **Compl

dsh-composer-plus README · Application language：Open **Settings → Composer Plus → Application language** and choose **System language** or one of 13 languages: English · 中文 · Türkçe · Español · Português (Brasil) · Français · Deutsch · Русский · 日本語 · 한국어 · Bahasa Indonesia · Tiếng Việt · हिन्दी

dsh-composer-plus README · Application language：The whole app switches immediately. The choice is dsh’s own saved `locale.preference` (the same one as General → Language), so it survives restarts. **System language** clears that choice: the desktop app follows the OS language, the web UI the browser language, and an unsupported language falls back to English. Installing the plugin never overrides a language you already picked.

dsh-composer-plus README · Application language：Each pack has 3,280 texts: every UI text of dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` (chats, sidebar, settings, approvals, schedules, file previews, plugin manager, plugin market), the plugin’s own controls, and the popular [dsh-rewind](https://github.com/SiriLee/dsh-rewind) plugin. Not translated: your messages, model output, code, slash-command names (`/plan`, `/compact`), provider-owned labels such as the `High` reasoning effort, other plugins’ texts, and the desktop app’s native menus/update dialogs (dsh ships those in English/Chinese only). Strings added by a newer dsh show in English until the packs are updated. If another plugin already provides a language, that plugin keeps it.

dsh-composer-plus README · Keyboard shortcuts：An open `/` or `@` menu keeps these keys for itself.
dsh-composer-plus README · Compatibility：Tested on dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` (desktop and web) and `0.2.1-rc.2` (web). CI runs the tests on every push.

dsh-composer-plus README · Privacy and security：- **Continue:** the authenticated local endpoint resumes only the last interrupted turn, rejects stale or duplicate requests, and preserves the existing approval hooks. It does not send a new user message.
- **Resume after restart:** off until you switch it on. The Host half keeps only chat ids and start times in `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-composer-plus/resume.json` (owner-only permissions), and nothing leaves your machine. It continues a chat only when dsh's own log says that dsh (not you) stopped its last turn. Approvals and Auto Review apply to the continued turn as usual.

dsh-composer-plus README · Privacy and security：- **Changes panel:** git runs read-only on your machine, in the chat's own folder, through dsh's authenticated `/api` channel. It never commits, stages or fetches, and only shows paths git itself listed. Tree lists up to 1000 local and remote branches and shows the newest 300 commits of one branch: its first-parent line, so a merge commit stands for the commits that it brought in. It never checks out a branch. **This chat** reads the chat's own log for the files that its file tools wrote and compares them with the chat's Turn rollback snapshot in a temporary folder that is deleted at once; it writes nothing to your repository or to the snapshot store.
- **Feature ideas:** nothing runs until you click **Suggest features**. Then the Host half reads only the chat's own folder (the browser never sends a path): the names of the top-level entries, the first 6 kB of the README, AGENTS.md and the manifest (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, …), an outline of the rest of the README (headings, table rows, list items; at most 6 kB) and the titles of the newest commits (`git log --format=%s`, at most 6 kB), at most 28 kB in

dsh-composer-plus README · Troubleshooting：- **No notifications on macOS:** System Settings → Notifications → DeepSeek Harness → allow. Choose Alerts to keep them on screen.
- **▶, queue grips, project status, the recent projects option, Collapse all projects, Copy path, the project search box, the next message prediction, the completion while typing, Allow for this chat or right-click missing after a dsh update:** these attach to dsh's current HTML because dsh has no slot for them yet. If dsh changes that markup they hide themselves; nothing else breaks. Please open an [issue](https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus/issues).
- **"Update failed" or "not installed from npm":** a copy linked from a local folder or renamed can't update itself; reinstall `dsh-composer-plus` from Settings → Plugins. Otherwise the message shows the first line of pnpm's error; **Check for updates** retries.
- **Mobile connect says the gateway is not running:** "no IPv4 address on en0" means this Mac has no Wi-Fi/Ethernet address; "EADDRINUSE" means another dsh (or app) uses port 19390 or 19391. Only one dsh can run Mobile connect at a time.
- **Mobile connect, Resume after restart or Content sear

dsh-composer-plus README · Limits：- Message-free Continue relies on dsh’s `agent/pre-step` → `agent/request` lifecycle. Recheck compatibility when upgrading dsh.
- **Feature ideas** keeps the cards in memory for each chat until dsh or the page reloads; then **Suggest features** asks the model again. The cards come in the UI language that dsh has when you click; after you change the language, cards already on the stack keep theirs and **More ideas** uses the new one. The model sees only the short project summary, not the code, so an idea can repeat something the project already has: skip it. The new chat runs in plan mode only when the profile has dsh's `/plan` command; otherwise the idea goes as an ordinary first message. The **Later** list belongs to the chat's folder path: the same folder opened through a symlink has its own list. It keeps at most 50 ideas per project (remove one to add more) and the same title only once. Dragging a card decides left or right only; use **↓** to save it and **▶** to build it now. A repeat is found by its title only: the model can still suggest an earlier idea under a new name; skip it. When the model answers only earlier ideas, nothing new shows:

dsh-composer-plus README · Limits：- **Content search** is dsh's own search, so it has dsh's limits. It searches only user and assistant messages: not tool output (commands, file contents, results), not reasoning, and it has no filter for user, assistant or tool messages. It matches whole words, not parts of a word (`deploy` does not find `deployment`); letters with accents match without them (`seker` finds `şeker`). One row per chat, with dsh's 240-character snippet, at most 20 rows.
- **Content search** cost, measured on a copy of 247 real chat logs (159 MB, dsh 0.2.1-rc.2, Apple Silicon, 32 GB): the first search after a start builds the index in about 15 s. During that time dsh's Host answers nothing for about 7 s, so other chats stop streaming for that moment (the page itself does not freeze). The Host's memory grows by about 1.1 GB at the peak; one minute later it is still about 0.5–0.6 GB above the start, until dsh quits. The index file is about 165 MB. Later searches take about 0.5 s. After a restart, the first search takes about 1 s (only new or changed chats are added) and adds about 70 MB. Switch it off if your computer has little memory.
- **Content search** applies only

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I add a Changes / git diff panel to DeepSeek Harness?** Install `dsh-composer-plus`, then right sidebar → `+` → **Changes**.

**Can dsh suggest features for my project, like swiping Tinder cards?** Yes: right sidebar → `+` → **Feature ideas** → **Suggest features**. Swipe right to start a new chat that plans the feature, click **▶ Build now** to start a chat that builds it at once without a plan, swipe left to skip.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can the dsh sidebar search find a chat by a word in its messages, not only its title?** Yes, with **Content search** (on by default): restart dsh once after you install the plugin, then use the magnifier next to **Workspaces**. Matching chats show the text around the word.

**Can I undo a turn and edit my prompt, like in OpenCode or Claude Code?** Yes, with **Turn rollback**: click **↶** on the message, choose **Chat and files**, edit the text that comes back in the composer and send it.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I delete a chat instead of archiving it?** Yes, with **Delete chat**: **…** → **Delete…**. The history goes to the Trash, so a mistake can be undone.

**How do I see which project a chat belongs to?** Look at the row under the composer: with **Project name in the composer** (on by default) it starts with the project name. Hover it for the folder path.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I get ↑/↓ message history in the dsh composer?** Install this plugin; in an empty composer `↑` / `↓` walk through messages you sent.

**How do I continue a stopped or failed dsh turn without typing "continue"?** With this plugin the Send button becomes **▶** after a stopped, failed or cut-off turn; one click resumes it.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Does dsh continue running chats after I quit and open it again?** Not by itself: dsh marks such a turn as interrupted and waits (a goal also waits for `/goal resume`). Switch on **Settings → Composer Plus → Resume after restart**: the chats that were working when dsh quit then continue by themselves at the next start.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Which model writes the prediction?** The model that you choose in **Settings → Composer Plus → Next message prediction → Model**. The list is dsh's own model list. **dsh default** follows dsh's default model. When dsh no longer lists the chosen model, the prediction uses the default. **Complete while typing** has its own **Model** menu: **Same as Next message prediction** (the default) follows the prediction's model; another choice is used for completions only. When dsh no longer lists that model, completions use the prediction's model.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can dsh improve my prompt before I send it, like the Enhance prompt button in Roo Code or Augment?** Yes, with **Improve prompt** (on by default): type a rough request and click the magic wand next to the model menu. It rewrites the text with this chat and the project as context, in your language, and does not send it. `Cmd/Ctrl+Z` or **Undo improvement** brings your text back. Choose its model in **Settings → Composer Plus → Improve prompt → Model**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can the agent stop marking its own work as done, like the verifier loops in loop engineering?** Yes, with **Goal check** (on by default): start a goal with `/goal`. When the agent says the goal is complete, the project's tests run and an independent model call checks the goal against the chat; if either fails, the goal stays open and the agent reads why. Set your own test command, a time limit or a token limit with **Edit** in the **Goal check** row under the goal.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can the agent remember my preferences across chats, like DS Bot's memory?** Yes, with **Project memory** (off by default): switch it on in **Settings → Composer Plus**. After each turn, your lasting preferences and decisions are kept as short notes for the chat's project, and each new chat in that project reads them. Ask the agent to remember something and it saves it at once. To see or change the notes, click **Open memory** in the same row and write what to change.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**I or the AI made a wrong change to the memory. Can I get the old notes back?** Yes, with **Memory version history** (on by default): in **Open memory**, select the project, then **History**. Select the version before the change to see what comes back, then **Restore**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I share the project memory with my team or another agent tool?** Yes, with **Export memory to AGENTS.md** (on by default): in **Open memory**, select the project, then **Export to AGENTS.md**. Check the diff, then **Write AGENTS.md**, and commit the file.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can the AI suggest what to keep from a long chat?** Yes, with **Suggest memory notes from a chat** (on by default, while **Project memory** is on): click **Suggest for memory** in the chat header, then **Accept** the notes worth keeping.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I see all my chats as a kanban board and start new ones from it?** Yes, with **Task board** (on by default): open it in the left sidebar. Each chat is a card in **Doing**, **Review** (it waits for you) or **Done**. **New task** opens dsh's new chat in the project, and the board comes back when your first message goes; click **Answer** on an orange card to answer it without opening the chat. **Clear all** in **Done** asks first and takes the finished cards that you read off the board; **Undo** and **Removed (N)** bring them back, and the chats stay in dsh.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can dsh back up my chats and settings, like dsh-backup?** Yes: **Settings → Composer Plus → Backup → Back up now**. It writes the same archive format into the same folder (`~/Desktop/dsh-backups`), so dsh-backup's archives show and restore too, and you can remove dsh-backup. Switch on **Automatic backup** for a schedule.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**dsh does not start any more. How do I restore a backup?** Open the backup folder (`~/Desktop/dsh-backups`) and double-click `Composer Plus Rescue.command` (Linux: `composer-plus-rescue.sh`, Windows: `Composer Plus Rescue.cmd`). Choose **3) Restore a backup**, pick one and type `RESTORE`. It works without dsh.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I move dsh to a new computer?** On the old one: **Backup** → **For another computer** next to a backup. Copy that folder to the new computer, install dsh there, quit it, open `Composer Plus Rescue` in the copied folder and restore. Enter your API keys again (they stay on the old computer).

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**A chat does not open after a crash. Can I repair it?** **Settings → Composer Plus → Session log check → Check session logs**. A damaged chat comes back from the newest backup with **Repair from backups** (the messages after that backup are lost).

**How do I reorder queued messages in dsh?** Drag the ⠿ grip on a queued message, or focus it and press `↑` / `↓`.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I fix a typo in a queued message?** Double-click the message in the queue, change the text and press `Enter` (`Esc` cancels). It keeps its place in the queue. You can also remove its images and files there, or add new ones.

**How do I clear all unread dots of a project at once?** Sidebar → the project's **…** button → **Mark all as read**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I link to one message in a long chat?** Yes: hover the message and click **🔗**. Send the link in a chat: on dsh 0.2.1 and later a click on it opens the chat at that message.

**I rolled back a turn by mistake. Can I get it back?** Yes, with **Redo** above the composer, right after the rollback: it starts a new chat from just before the rollback with the same messages, and **Chat and files** also puts the files back.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Which chat changed this file?** Right sidebar → **Changes** → the file's **…** → **Chats that changed this file**. Click a row to open that chat at the request that made the change.

**Can I search inside one long chat?** Yes: press `Cmd+F` on a Mac (`Ctrl+F` on Windows and Linux) in the chat. **Find in chat** highlights every match and moves between them with `Enter` and `Shift+Enter`.
dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I see only the files that one chat changed?** Right sidebar → **Changes** → **This chat**. Click **␣** to hide changes that are only whitespace.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I stop the agent from running `npm publish` or `git push --force`?** **Settings → Composer Plus → Blocked commands**: type `npm publish`, choose **block** or **ask first**, then click **Add**. **block** refuses the command and the agent asks you; **ask first** shows the approval card each time. Protected files covers the agent's file tools; Blocked commands covers its shell commands.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I tell the agent why I rejected a tool call?** Yes, with **Reject with note** (on by default): click **Reject with note…** on the approval card, write why or what to do instead, and click **Reject**. The agent reads the rejection and your note in the same turn.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I give the agent a password or a token without writing it in the chat?** With **Secret input** (on by default): ask the agent to use `request_secret`, or wait until it asks. Type the value in the card on the tool's row and click **Save**. The agent gets only the path of a file that holds the value, and the file is deleted when the turn ends.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I answer one part of a long answer?** Select that part and click **Quote** above the selection (**Quote in reply**, on by default). The part goes into the composer as a `> …` quote, and you write your reply below it.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I show the agent the exact lines of a file?** Open the file in the right sidebar (**Workspace files**), select the lines and click **Quote** above the selection (**Quote from file preview**, on by default). The composer gets the path and the line numbers (for example `src/login.js:2-3`) and the lines as a code block; write your question below them.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I ask something while the agent works, without stopping it?** Type the question and click **Ask in a side chat** in the composer (**Side chat**, on by default). A read-only copy of the chat answers it while the chat goes on. In the side chat, **Bring back** puts the answer into the chat's composer.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I tell the agent what to change in its diff?** In **Changes panel**, open the file's diff, click **+** at a line and write a note (**Diff notes**, on by default). Then click **Send to composer**: the notes go into the composer with the file, the line numbers and the lines.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I stop Auto Review asking about the same tool in one chat?** Click **Allow for this chat** on the approval card. It covers that exact tool in that chat only, for 1 hour by default; revoke it from the header chip. Change the time in **Settings → Composer Plus → Allow for this chat**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**I lost my iPhone. How do I stop it from reaching my Mac?** Click **Mobile connect** at the bottom left of the sidebar and click **Remove** next to that iPhone. Its key stops working at once; it can come back only with a new pairing that you approve on the Mac.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I continue a chat of my other Mac from this one?** On the other Mac, switch on **Settings → Composer Plus → Remote computers** and **Let other computers open this Mac**, click **Create pairing link** and copy the link (send it to yourself, for example with AirDrop or Notes). On this Mac, switch on **Remote computers** too, pick **Add a computer…** in the picker of the left sidebar (right of the brand, above **New session**), paste the link, type a **Name** and click **Connect**, then click **Approve** on the other Mac. From then on, pick that computer in the same menu: it fills this window. Pick **This Mac** in the same place to come back; this Mac's chats keep running meanwhile.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I lock Tether with Face ID?** Yes: in Tether, **Settings → Privacy → Lock with Face ID**. Tether then asks for Face ID (or the passcode) when it opens and when you come back to it.

**How do I show only the projects I used today in the dsh sidebar?** Sidebar → view options (sliders icon) → **Active in the last 2 hours**. Select it again to show all projects.

**How do I copy a project's folder path in dsh?** Right-click the project in the sidebar → **Copy path**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I collapse all projects in the dsh sidebar at once?** Click the collapse button next to the view options (sliders icon). It shows while at least one project is open.

**How do I get macOS / Windows notifications when a dsh task finishes or needs approval?** Keep **Background notifications** on (default) and allow notifications for DeepSeek Harness in the OS settings.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can dsh open the chat that asks me a question by itself?** Yes, with **Open waiting chat when idle** (on by default): when a chat waits for an answer, an approval or a plan review and you do not use dsh for 30 seconds, dsh opens it. A chat that finished a turn that you have not read (the green dot) opens the same way, after the orange ones. While you type, scroll or move the mouse, it waits.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I jump to the next chat that waits for me?** Yes, with **Next waiting chat** (on by default): press `Cmd+Shift+E` (`Ctrl+Shift+E` on Windows and Linux) or click the button with the count in the sidebar header. Chats that ask a question or wait for an approval come first, then chats that finished a turn that you have not read.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I answer an agent's options with one click?** Yes, with **Option buttons** (on by default): when an answer ends with an "Options" list, click a button under it. It sends "Option N: …" as your message. On a question card of the agent, press 1–9.

**How do I switch the DeepSeek Harness interface to Turkish, Spanish, Japanese…?** Settings → Composer Plus → **Application language**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I use dsh from my iPhone?** Build the Tether app from `tether/ios` (Xcode), switch on **Settings → Composer Plus → Mobile connect (iPhone)**, click **Mobile connect** at the bottom left, scan the QR code (iPhone Camera or **Scan code** in Tether), tap **Connect** and click **Approve**. Away from home, use Tailscale on both devices.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I make New session always open in the same project?** Settings → Composer Plus → **Default workspace for New session** → **Open New session in** → choose the project. The `+` next to another project still opens that project.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I run several features of one project at the same time, each on its own branch?** With **Branch per chat**: on the New chat screen, the branch button shows **New branch** by default: send the first message. Each chat gets its own branch and worktree folder, with your `.env` and `node_modules` when `.worktreeinclude` lists them. The chat header shows which branch you are on.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can the sidebar show each branch of a project, and move my chat when the agent creates a branch?** Yes, with **Branches in the workspace tree** (off by default): switch it on in Settings → Composer Plus, then choose dsh's **View options** → **Workspace Tree**. Each branch with a worktree in `<project>/.worktrees/` shows inside its project. When you ask the agent in the project folder to create a branch and work there, and the folder has no uncommitted changes, the chat moves into the branch by itself. Delete the branch's folder and it leaves the list; its chats go to **Ungrouped**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can I send a photo from my iPhone?** Yes. In a Tether chat, tap **+** next to the message field → Camera, Photos (up to 4) or Paste image. The photos go to the chat on the Mac as attachments of your message, so the model sees them.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Can dsh run the next command without asking the model again?** Yes, with **Planned steps** (off by default): switch it on in Settings → Composer Plus. The model can then plan its next commands with a condition, for example "run the tests when the build passes", and Composer Plus runs a step without a new model call when the result meets the condition. Approvals and the sandbox stay as they are.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Where does the Turkish skill come from, and can I remove it?** From [yucezerey/turkish-anti-ai-skill](https://github.com/yucezerey/turkish-anti-ai-skill) on GitHub (MIT). Composer Plus installs it only while **Application language** is Türkçe, keeps only its Markdown files and runs none of its scripts. To remove it, switch off **Turkish skill pack** in Settings → Composer Plus: the skill and the downloaded copy go at once.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How do I report a bug or ask for a feature in Composer Plus?** Settings → Composer Plus → **Report an issue…** (or a chat's **…** menu → **Report a Composer Plus issue…**). Pick a type, describe it in your own language and click **Write draft**. Check the English draft, then click **Open issue**.

dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**How can the agent clean up a messy codebase?** Type `/untangle-codebase` in a chat (**Untangle codebase**, on by default), optionally with an area, for example `/untangle-codebase src/api`. The agent first lists the copies, hidden links, needless wrappers, dead code and special cases, then fixes them as a goal and checks again with subagents. Start it in a chat of **Branch per chat**, so the work stays on its own branch.
dsh-composer-plus README · FAQ：**Does it work with the desktop app?** Yes: Settings → Plugins → **Add plugin** → `dsh-composer-plus`. Tested on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (desktop and web) and 0.2.1-rc.2 (web).

Add the feature id to `SHOT_OF` in `client.js` and to `SHOTS` in `index.js`, and ship `assets/features/<id>.webp` (taken from the throwaway demo dsh, English UI, about 60 kB or less). Add the feature, with the same image, to `docs/features.json` and run `npm run build:readme`: it writes the feature table of `README.md` and of each translated `README.<id>.md`, and the list in `llms.txt`. `test/shots.test.mjs` fails when a feature has no screenshot, and `test/browser-settings-shots.mjs` checks the real Settings page. The full checklist for every change is in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
